title: StitchVector line recovery Phase C: fragment linking (S2) isolated from detection, then frozen P1 detector + linker. Pushed and remote-verified before test seeds are generated.
question: Given line fragments, can a label-free linker join the fragments that belong together with very few wrong links, and hold back ambiguous cases as UNCERTAIN instead of guessing?
phaseA_basis: docs/research/stitchvector/line_recovery_review.md section 1 (descriptive analysis of frozen P1 test seeds 2001-2005; P1 scores unchanged)

levels.L1: controlled fragments (sv_lr_bench.scene + cut): known lines are rendered (anti-aliasing, noise sigma 2, JPEG 75), then cut into fragments at crossings with later-drawn lines (occluded gaps) and at 1-3 random visible gaps of 2-16 px where the ink is still in the image. True links = consecutive fragments of one line. Scenes contain shaded red 2/3 px, black 1/3 px, pale 1 px, red 2->5 px, a parallel red pair 5 px apart, two collinear black lines with a real 10 px ink-free gap, a T-junction where a line ends 4 px from another line, a shallow 25 deg black crossing, and two fill-coloured bands also cut into fragments.
levels.L2: frozen P1 detector (sv_autoline, 32e8a41) on sv_synth tiles, then the linker; links scored by whether both fragments belong to the same truth line (fragment owner = truth line holding >= 60% of its length within 2 px; fragments following 2+ truth lines over >= 10 px each are unassignable)

dev_disclosure: The linker (sv_linker.py) was written and tuned on dev seeds only (L1 1101-1103, L2 1001-1003, the P1 dev seeds). Changes made after looking at dev scores: r_max 16->24, a stricter angle (25 deg) for gaps > 8 px, frag_col_dE 25->35, occl_dmax 14->24, and touching ends now need bend <= 30 deg and colour dE <= 15. A width_diff change (2.5->1.5) was tried and reverted. Dev L1: 84 links, 82 correct (precision 0.976, recall 0.667). Dev L2: 3-9 links per tile, 1 link per tile between fragments of different truth lines in 2 of 3 tiles. Test seeds 3101-3105 and 3001-3005 were never generated before freeze; P1 test seeds 2001-2005 are not used.
linker: sv_linker.link with LK.P (frozen in code and below): end tangents measured 2-10 px back from each end; candidates within r_max with similar colour and width and end angles <= ang_max (<= ang_max_long beyond long_d); image support sampled along a cubic Hermite bridge (ink above c_low of the fragments' colour supports; colour of another nearby fragment is neutral = occluded); bridges with no visible evidence allowed only up to occl_dmax with small angles (INFERRED_OCCLUDED); maximum-weight matching; matches within margin of an alternative are UNCERTAIN; statuses CONFIRMED / INFERRED / INFERRED_OCCLUDED

L1: precision = correct / predicted links (band-band links reported separately)
recall = correct / true non-band pairs, split by gap kind (occluded / visible) and length (<= 8 / > 8 px)
wrong links by kind, in particular must-not cases: parallel pair, real termination, T-junction, band to line
UNCERTAIN count and how many sit on true pairs
components per line (1 = fully recovered), impure components (fragments of 2+ lines merged)
L2: links, links within one truth line, links across truth lines, unassignable
P1 recall and objects_covering per line before vs after linking

reading.precision_first: a wrong link merges two different lines and is worse than a missing link; the linker is useful only if wrong links are rare, recall is secondary
reading.no_single_pass: no single pass/fail for the route; numbers are read jointly with the must-not cases

stop_rule: one run on test seeds, <= 10 min CPU; no code or parameter change after the first number
